description: This file defines kernel memory management interfaces, constants, and macros for the Zephyr RTOS, including memory mapping, permissions, cache modes, and related functions.

methods.name: k_mem_free_get
methods.description: Returns the amount of free physical RAM in bytes.

methods.name: k_mem_map
methods.description: Maps anonymous memory into Zephyr's address space with specified size and flags.

methods.name: k_mem_unmap
methods.description: Removes a memory mapping for a specified region.

methods.name: k_mem_region_align
methods.description: Provides an aligned region covering a given address and size.
